titleEn: Trump Rally at Madison Square Garden
titleZh: 特朗普在麦迪逊广场花园的集会
summaryEn: Musk's full MSG rally speech for Trump on government efficiency, free speech and getting out the vote.
summaryZh: 马斯克在麦迪逊广场花园为特朗普举行的集会上发表的完整演讲，内容涉及政府效率、言论自由以及动员投票。

segments.textEn: Massive, overwhelming sweep of every swing state. And even some of the states that aren't people don't think are swing states.

segments.textEn: Massive crushing victory. Get everyone, friends, family, people on the street. Put the signs up, put the hat on, let's go.

segments.textEn: And with that, it is my honor to introduce the First Lady, Melania Trump.
segments.textZh: 说到这里，我很荣幸地介绍第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普。
